mentions.heading: We may experience issues or delays in developing, launching and ramping the production of our products, services and features
mentions.risk_name: Product launch and production ramp delays
mentions.detail: Depends on autonomous driving, Cybercab Robotaxi, mass-market vehicles, Bots; past ramp bottlenecks; cost and profitability targets at risk
mentions.quote: In particular, our future business depends on development of our driver assistance systems and autonomous driving solutions and increasing the production of mass-market vehicles, including Cybercab, our purpose-built Robotaxi product.

mentions.heading: AI development challenges including energy and processing power for data centers
mentions.detail: AI services face energy availability and cost, processing power limitations and substantial data center power requirements
mentions.quote: In addition, as we continue to develop our artificial intelligence services and products, we may face many additional challenges, including the availability and cost of energy, processing power limitations and the substantial power requirements for our data centers.
